title: triticum aestivum var. albidum
intro: Triticum aestivum var. albidum, commonly known as White Wheat, is a subspecies of the common wheat (Triticum aestivum) plant. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of White Wheat include its ability to soothe digestive issues, lower blood pressure, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents present in White Wheat include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
